name: Surikomi Shoujo ~Hontou ni Kimi wa Boku no Kanojo Nandayo~
original_name: 擦り込み少女～本当に君はボクの彼女なんだよ～
source:
After an accident in school, the heroine suffer from amnesia, and the main character pretend to be her boyfriend at that time.
Superposing lies, fighting against contradictions, he's trying to force her into believing his lie, both in mind and body.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=535145]Getchu[/url]]
